title: 'Balde' just one of the El Niño measures Marcos Jr. mentioned — Palace
summary: The Palace on Tuesday defended President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. from public criticism of his suggestion for Filipinos to collect rainwater in pails and buckets in anticipation of the El Niño phenomenon.
